Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

About the Job

We are looking for an experienced Product Director to lead our core payment portfolios, encompassing Payments Acceptance (Cards & LPMs) and Payouts. In this role, you will define the long-term product vision, set the strategic roadmap, and drive the evolution of our B2B payments infrastructure. We are seeking a visionary product leader who has a deep understanding of the payments industry, knows what best-in-class looks like, and can elevate our product offerings to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions across multiple regions.

What you’ll do in this role:

• Define and own the long-term product strategy and comprehensive roadmaps for large-scale payment portfolios, focusing on future growth and innovation.
• Drive product performance and take ownership of key commercial and technical metrics, including authorization/success rates, total payment volume (TPV), cost of acceptance, and margin optimization.
• Build and scale robust B2B payment products and infrastructure across multiple regions and complex regulatory jurisdictions.
• Partner closely with engineering teams, utilizing your technical background to guide how payment systems, connections, and integrations work together seamlessly.
• Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of Product Managers and Senior Product Managers, fostering a culture of strategic thinking paired with hands-on product ownership.

What you’ll need in this role:

• 8+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proven track record of leading product teams and owning end-to-end strategy.
• Deep knowledge of card acquiring and/or local payment methods, specifically gained from working at a Payment Service Provider (PSP) or a dedicated payments technology company.
• Demonstrated experience building and managing large B2B payment portfolios rather than just individual features.
• Highly metrics-minded and analytical, with direct experience managing payments economics and performance indicators.
• Technical fluency necessary to understand and navigate complex payment architectures and integrations.
• Preferred: Experience with payouts/disbursements, Southeast Asia or emerging market payment methods (e-wallets, QR, etc.), multi-acquirer routing, and fraud/risk management.

Earlier this year, Unilever announced an agreement to combine its Foods business with McCormick & Company, creating a scaled global flavour powerhouse. The proposed combination would bring together iconic Foods brands, including Hellmann’s and Knorr, with McCormick’s portfolio to create a global leader across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by strong retail and foodservice platforms. McCormick brings more than 135 years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, with completion estimated for mid-2027.

Function/Business Unit: Customer Development/Unilever Food Solutions (UFS)

Job title: UFS ID Key Account Manager Chains

Reporting to: Key Account Lead

Role Purpose

Driving growth with chain customers in the HORECA channel by managing strategic partnerships, co-creating menu solutions, and leading joint business planning. Responsible for achieving sales targets, building strong customer relationships, ensuring operational excellence, and collaborating with cross-functional teams for sustainable business growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Translate UFS strategy into an actionable plan for the Chain channel.
• Achieve annual and monthly business targets through effective account management.
• Develop, execute and monitor Joint business plans and business terms specific to Chains customers, including Local Chain accounts.
• Build and manage strong multi-level relationships (contact matrix) within Chains customers organizations to ensure sustainable business contribution.
• Deliver Growth and development: drive volume, share and account productivity.
• Deliver wins and retains profitable business with chain customers.
• Ensure operational Excellence by working closely with supply chain to ensure reliable supply, and delivery.
• Lead and collaborate with Chefs and marketing to deliver culinary solutions and demand-generation activities.
• Manage budgets and ensure efficient use of resources.
• Gather insights from customers and dinners to drive menu innovation and business solutions.
• Monitor competitor activities and adapt strategies to maintain competitive edge.
• Develop new accounts and drive SKU penetration across customers.
• Work closely with other functions: Area Business Managers, Chef, Chains Marketing, CSP, R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, and CD Operations to ensure all operations are being smoothly run.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

Experience & Qualification

• Minimum of 4 years’ proven experience in Foodservice Account Management
• Minimum bachelor’s degree education
• High passion for culinary business; able to do simple cooking & product applications
• Strong leadership, commercial acumen, and proven ability to manage key accounts
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
• Able to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities and provide customized solutions
• Self-motivated, hardworking, and able to work independently with a strong sale drive
• High business analytical, commercial acumen & entrepreneurial mindset
• Willing to travel as needed
• Preferably fluent in English
• Good interpersonal skills

Functional Skills

• Account Management
• Business Acumen
• Strong Negotiation Skill
• Effective Communication
• Strategic Influencing
• Strategic Selling
• Project Management

Leadership Skills

• You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.
• As an individual, you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better.

CRITICAL SOL (STANDARDS OF LEADERSHIP) BEHAVIORS

PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Has an owner’s mindset, using data and insight to make decisions.

PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.

CONSUMER LOVE: Whatever their role, always looks for better ways to serve consumers. Invest time inside and outside to understand the needs of consumers.

PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.

AGILITY: Explores the world around them, continually learning and developing their skills.

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.
